post.summary: Create a new manual renewal by member_id (/api/v1/membership/renewals/manual)
post.description:
## Business Logic > Execute under the same DB transaction 1. Receive request body, validate required fields, and type 2. Insert a new record into table `membership_renewals` - member_id - payment_slip_file_path = input - payment_date_at = NOW() - status = `APPROVED` 3. Update member by id - status = `ACTIVE` - expires_at= NOW + 1year, adjust end of year - expires_at: 2026-12-31T23:59:59+07:00 - renewal_success_count += 1 - latest_renewal_status = `APPROVED` - updated_at = NOW() 4. API Response inserted record `renewal_id` ## ✍️Pseudocode 1. Receive request body: - member_id = body.member_id - payment_slip = body.payment_slip 2. Validate required fields: - break member_id is missing or invalid: -> Return 400 Bad Request - break missing payment_slip -> Return 400 Bad Request 3. Check member exists and validate status: ```sql SELECT id, status, expires_at FROM members WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL; ``` -> break not found member: Return 404 Not Found -> break if member.status = 'RESIGNED': Return 403 Forbidden `{ error_message: "resigned members cannot submit renewal requests" }` -> break member.status = `PENDING_RENEWAL` Return 409 Conflict `{ error_message: "member already have a pending renewal request" }` 4. Calculate new expires_at (End of Next Year): - current_year = current_year + 1 - next_year = current_year + 1 - expires_at = `${next_year}-12-31T23:59:59+07:00` 5. Begin DB transaction: `BEGIN` 6. Insert a new renewal record: ```sql INSERT INTO membership_renewals (member_id, payment_slip_file_path, payment_date_at, status) VALUES ($1, $2, NOW(), 'APPROVED') RETURNING id; ``` 7. Update member status: ```sql UPDATE members SET status = 'ACTIVE', expires_at = $3, renewal_success_count = renewal_success_count + 1, latest_renewal_status = 'APPROVED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1; ``` 8. Commit transaction: `COMMIT` 9. Return 201 Created ## Sequence Diagram ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant browser as Browser (Admin) participant nextjsapi as Next.js /api participant database as PostgreSQL autonumber browser->>nextjsapi: POST /api/v1/membership/renewals/manual
{ member_id: 15, payment_slip: "..." } nextjsapi -->> nextjsapi: Validate request body:
1. member_id required
2. payment_slip required break Validate request body failed nextjsapi-->>browser: 400 Bad Request { error_message: "..." } end nextjsapi->>+database: SELECT id, status, expires_at FROM members
WHERE id = 15 AND deleted_at IS NULL database-->>-nextjsapi: Return member row { id: 15, status: 'EXPIRED', expires_at: ... } break Member not found nextjsapi-->>browser: 404 Not Found { error_message: "Member not found" } end break member.status = 'RESIGNED' nextjsapi-->>browser: 403 Forbidden { error_message: "Cannot create manual renewal for resigned members" } end break member.status = 'PENDING_RENEWAL' nextjsapi-->>browser: 409 Conflict { error_message: "Member already has a pending renewal request..." } end nextjsapi -->> nextjsapi: Calculate expires_at:
next_year = current_year + 1
expires_at = `${next_year}-12-31T23:59:59+07:00` nextjsapi->>database: BEGIN Transaction rect rgb(235, 245, 255) Note over nextjsapi,database: Execute Under Database Transaction nextjsapi->>+database: INSERT INTO membership_renewals
(member_id, payment_slip_file_path, payment_date_at, status)
VALUES (15, '...', NOW(), 'APPROVED')
RETURNING id database-->>-nextjsapi: Return inserted_id { id: 71 } nextjsapi->+database: UPDATE members
SET status = 'ACTIVE',
expires_at = '2026-12-31T23:59:59+07:00',
renewal_success_count = renewal_success_count + 1,
latest_renewal_status = 'APPROVED',
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = 15 database-->>-nextjsapi: Return OK end nextjsapi->>database: COMMIT database-->>nextjsapi: OK nextjsapi-->>browser: 201 Created ```
